# Flash Trade V2 MCP Server

> MCP server for Flash Trade V2 — a Solana perpetuals DEX running on a MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup (ER). Gives AI agents typed tools to read market data, set up trading accounts (baskets + deposit ledger), preview and build unsigned transactions, and sign/submit them to the correct chain.

## Key Information

- Non-custodial: every transaction tool returns an unsigned base64 transaction; the user (or sign_and_send with a local keypair) signs and submits.
- V2 spans TWO chains: TRADING transactions submit to the Ephemeral Rollup RPC; ACCOUNT SETUP + WITHDRAWAL transactions submit to the base-chain Solana RPC. Submitting to the wrong chain fails to land — every transaction tool tells you which value to pass to sign_and_send.
- Transactions come back PARTIALLY SIGNED (the server pre-filled its signer slots and chose the blockhash). The wallet adds only its own signature; never replace the blockhash.
- Prices are Pyth Lazer oracles. The V2 API is mainnet.
- The hosted API serves at ROOT (https://flashapi.trade). The documented /v2 prefix is not deployed; set FLASH_API_URL to override.

## Account lifecycle (one-time per wallet, IN ORDER)

The on-chain program enforces this order; the API does not. Detect "not set up" via get_owner (basketPubkey = null).

1. init_basket — create the Basket PDA (holds all positions + orders). Base chain.
2. init_deposit_ledger — create the collateral inbox. Base chain.
3. delegate_basket — hand the basket to the MagicBlock validator. Base chain.
4. deposit_direct — fund the vault (takes a token MINT, not a symbol). Base chain.
Then trade on the Ephemeral Rollup. Withdraw is two steps: request_withdrawal → (wait ~30–90s) → execute_withdrawal (base chain).

## Critical Rules

- COLLATERAL MINIMUM: limit orders, take-profit, and stop-loss require >$10 collateral AFTER entry fees. Open with at least $11–12 if you plan to set TP/SL/limit.
- MINT vs SYMBOL: deposit_direct / request_withdrawal / execute_withdrawal take a token MINT (resolve via get_tokens); every trading tool takes a SYMBOL. An unknown mint silently assumes 6 decimals — wrong for Token-2022.
- PnL: this server computes position PnL from the LIVE MARK PRICE (the indexer's pnl fields are spread-distorted and degenerate near liquidation). Trust the tool's PnL, not raw indexer numbers.
- ALWAYS show the preview (entry, fees, leverage, liquidation) before signing. Funds move only on explicit user approval; never bundle a deposit into setup.
- Edit semantics differ: edit_trigger_order requires BOTH price and size; edit_limit_order treats omitted fields as KEEP EXISTING.
- Latency: "30–50 ms fills" are measured near the validator; from a distant client expect a higher round-trip (geography, not the rollup).

## Read Tools

- [health_check]: API status, program (ER), config env, account counts
- [get_tokens]: symbols + MINT addresses + decimals + Token-2022 flag (resolve mints for deposits here)
- [get_prices] / [get_price]: live oracle prices
- [get_markets] / [get_market]: markets (symbol-resolved list / raw account)
- [get_pools] / [get_pool]: raw pool accounts
- [get_custodies] / [get_custody]: raw custody accounts (fee/spread/borrow params)
- [get_pool_data]: pool AUM, LP price, utilization
- [get_owner]: THE V2 read model — setup status + positions (mark-price PnL) + orders in one call
- [get_positions] / [get_orders]: owner-scoped views over the same snapshot
- [get_basket]: raw basket account by PDA (from get_owner)
- [get_account_summary]: complete wallet overview (recommended first call for a wallet)
- [get_trading_overview]: markets + prices + pool utilization (recommended first call for planning trades)

## Preview Tools (no transaction)

- [preview_limit_order_fees], [preview_exit_fee], [preview_tp_sl], [preview_margin]

## Account Setup Tools (base chain — unsigned tx)

- [init_basket], [init_deposit_ledger], [delegate_basket], [deposit_direct]

## Trading Tools (Ephemeral Rollup — unsigned tx)

- [open_position]: open/increase; omit owner for a FREE QUOTE (no tx). Params: input_token_symbol, output_token_symbol, input_amount, leverage, trade_type, [owner]
- [close_position]: close full/partial by market_symbol + side ("0" or ≥97% = full)
- [reverse_position]: flip LONG↔SHORT (2% haircut on proceeds)
- [add_collateral] / [remove_collateral]: adjust margin by market_symbol + side
- [place_tp_sl]: TP and/or SL bracket in one atomic tx
- [place_trigger_order] / [edit_trigger_order] / [cancel_trigger_order] / [cancel_all_trigger_orders]: TP/SL management (cancel_trigger_order order_id 255 = all)
- [edit_limit_order] / [cancel_limit_order]: resting limit-order management

## Withdrawal Tools (base chain — unsigned tx)

- [request_withdrawal]: escrow + schedule settlement (takes a mint)
- [execute_withdrawal]: move settled funds to the wallet. 0xbc4 / AccountNotInitialized = settlement hasn't crossed yet (~30–90s) — a timing state, retry.

## Signing Tool

- [sign_and_send]: sign a base64 transaction with the local keypair and submit. REQUIRES a `network` argument ("er" for trading, "base" for setup/withdrawal) — pass the exact value the transaction tool gave you.

## Typical Workflow (new wallet)

1. health_check → get_trading_overview
2. get_owner(owner) → if basketPubkey is null, set up: init_basket → init_deposit_ledger → delegate_basket → deposit_direct (each: sign_and_send network="base")
3. get_tokens → resolve the collateral mint for deposit_direct
4. open_position(input_amount="12", owner=…) → show preview → sign_and_send(network="er")
5. place_tp_sl → sign_and_send(network="er")
6. get_account_summary(owner) → verify
7. close_position → sign_and_send(network="er")
8. request_withdrawal → (wait) → execute_withdrawal → each sign_and_send(network="base")

## Configuration

- FLASH_API_URL: REST base (default https://flashapi.trade — root; /v2 edge not deployed)
- ER_RPC_URL: Ephemeral Rollup RPC for trading txs (default https://flash.magicblock.xyz)
- SOLANA_RPC_URL: base-chain RPC for setup/withdrawal txs (default mainnet-beta)
- FLASH_API_TIMEOUT, WALLET_PUBKEY, KEYPAIR_PATH: optional
